youtube_description:
Extraordinary people often have a #gravity to them that pulls ideas, resources and history into their orbit. Dr. Craig Venter is a neutron star in the #SanDiego #LifeSciences Cluster!

But even the brightest #stars are pulled by larger gravitational bodies, as I once experienced all the way from #NewYork. Now, we have finally arrived at the moment of #eclipse for San Diego's Constellations of Creativity.

Watch carefully, as this city emerges out of gentle obscurity into a global #technology #superpower.

We invite you to come here if you dream of building what only exists in the wild boundaries between imagination and reality.

www.innovation-labs.co

A CO Network Short by Tristen Tyler Blake
